name: git-deploy-watch
description: Watch an explicitly approved public Git branch and queue one guarded agent-driven deployment per new revision. Checks are read-only; the agent builds, deploys, verifies and acknowledges the configured workflow.

REPO_URL.prompt: Public HTTPS Git repository URL, without credentials.

BRANCH.prompt: Exact branch to watch. Defaults to master.

WORKFLOW.prompt: Owner-approved deployment steps, validation gates and rollback policy. Never include credentials.

CHECK_SECONDS.prompt: Read-only polling interval, 60-86400 seconds. Defaults to 300.
